description: Twelve new natural-prose retrieval cases reserved for the first beam-16 dense-versus-compiler YaRN paper sweep. Do not use for tuning, screening, selector training, or packet-format development before that run.

cases.evidence: The final geological survey assigned the dark basalt seam to the Vesper Member. Petrographic review distinguished it from the overlying ash-rich unit despite their similar field color.
cases.needle: The final geological survey assigned the dark basalt seam to the Vesper Member.
cases.question: Question: Which geological member contains the dark basalt seam? Answer with only the member name.
distractors: An early field map placed the seam in the Caligo Member, but laboratory review rejected that assignment.
The pale tuff above the seam remains part of the Orison Member.
A neighboring quarry exposes the Meridian Member without the dark basalt seam.

cases.evidence: Protocol amendment seven sets the evening Nalorex dose at 18 milligrams for the maintenance cohort. The safety committee approved the change after reviewing the second pharmacokinetic panel.
cases.needle: Protocol amendment seven sets the evening Nalorex dose at 18 milligrams for the maintenance cohort.
cases.question: Question: What evening Nalorex dose does amendment seven set for the maintenance cohort? Answer with only the dose.
distractors: The induction cohort receives 24 milligrams in the morning under a different schedule.
A draft amendment proposed 16 milligrams of Nalorex but was withdrawn before approval.
The placebo preparation is dispensed in an 18-milliliter container, which is not a dose.

cases.evidence: The accession inventory places the signed Elmridge correspondence in the Heron document case. Its wax-seal fragments are enclosed in a separate sleeve within the same case.
cases.needle: The accession inventory places the signed Elmridge correspondence in the Heron document case.
cases.question: Question: Which document case contains the signed Elmridge correspondence? Answer with only the case name.
distractors: The Kestrel case contains unsigned Elmridge translation drafts.
A superseded shelf list incorrectly sent researchers to the Lark document case.
The Finch cabinet stores photographs of the signing ceremony rather than the correspondence.

cases.evidence: The Solstice relay opens its local control socket at run/solstice/control.sock after initialization. Health checks use the socket only after the readiness marker appears.
cases.needle: The Solstice relay opens its local control socket at run/solstice/control.sock after initialization.
cases.question: Question: At what path does the Solstice relay open its local control socket? Answer with only the path.
distractors: Relay diagnostics are appended to logs/solstice/control.log and cannot accept commands.
The retired Equinox relay used run/equinox/relay.sock.
A packaging example mentions tmp/solstice.sock but the production service never binds there.

cases.evidence: The autumn census confirmed Marrow Islet as the only nesting site used by the silver-crowned tern in the inner bay. Observers recorded fledglings on three ledges after the storm season.
cases.needle: The autumn census confirmed Marrow Islet as the only nesting site used by the silver-crowned tern in the inner bay.
cases.question: Question: Which inner-bay site did the census confirm for the silver-crowned tern? Answer with only the site name.
distractors: Silver-crowned terns feed near Pelican Shoal but no nests were found there.
A spring reconnaissance listed Tern Rock as a possible site before the autumn census.
Outer-bay cormorants occupy Lantern Islet, a different colony.

cases.evidence: The revised evening notice assigns the Northstar sleeper to platform 8 at Bellweather Central. The platform change begins with Friday's departure and remains in force through the bridge works.
cases.needle: The revised evening notice assigns the Northstar sleeper to platform 8 at Bellweather Central.
cases.question: Question: Which platform is assigned to the Northstar sleeper at Bellweather Central? Answer with only the platform number.
distractors: The Northstar used platform 6 before the bridge works began.
A preliminary notice proposed platform 9 but was replaced by the revised notice.
The Daybreak express continues to depart from platform 8 in the morning.

cases.evidence: The consolidated observatory catalog names the corrected polar mosaic Polaris Field 508. The revision merges two overlapping notebook entries and applies the new astrometric solution.
cases.needle: The consolidated observatory catalog names the corrected polar mosaic Polaris Field 508.
cases.question: Question: What name does the consolidated catalog give the corrected polar mosaic? Answer with only the catalog name.
distractors: Polaris Field 580 is a southern standard field used for calibration.
The notebook label Polar Mosaic Five was retired during consolidation.
Polaris Field 518 borders the corrected mosaic but remains a separate entry.

cases.evidence: The harbor directive reserves 76.3 megahertz for the Bracken Point emergency beacon. Operators must verify the frequency before the monthly battery exercise.
cases.needle: The harbor directive reserves 76.3 megahertz for the Bracken Point emergency beacon.
cases.question: Question: What frequency is reserved for the Bracken Point emergency beacon? Answer with only the frequency.
distractors: Routine harbor notices use 76.8 megahertz.
An obsolete directive listed 73.6 megahertz for Bracken Point.
The portable rescue radios switch to 76.3 kilohertz during a bench test, not beacon operation.

cases.evidence: The certified minutes show that the Eastbank drainage amendment passed by 19 votes to 6. The clerk corrected the tally before the mayor signed the record.
cases.needle: The certified minutes show that the Eastbank drainage amendment passed by 19 votes to 6.
cases.question: Question: What vote tally passed the Eastbank drainage amendment? Answer with only the tally.
distractors: The preliminary clerk sheet reported 18 votes to 7 before correction.
A separate parks motion passed 16 votes to 9 later that evening.
The drainage committee recommended the amendment by a 6-to-2 vote.

cases.evidence: The conservation dossier dates the azurite restoration on the Selwyn panel to 1911. Ultraviolet imaging separates that campaign from a smaller varnish repair completed decades later.
cases.needle: The conservation dossier dates the azurite restoration on the Selwyn panel to 1911.
cases.question: Question: In what year was the azurite restoration on the Selwyn panel completed? Answer with only the year.
distractors: A 1917 inventory describes the restored panel but does not date the treatment.
The varnish repair was completed in 1941.
A draft label mistakenly attributed the azurite restoration to 1901.

cases.evidence: The highland field trial selected Lumen barley for expanded planting after the third frost season. Its emergence remained uniform on the exposed northern plots.
cases.needle: The highland field trial selected Lumen barley for expanded planting after the third frost season.
cases.question: Question: Which barley variety did the highland field trial select for expanded planting? Answer with only the variety.
distractors: Haven barley produced a larger early yield but suffered frost damage.
A planning memo recommended Lucent barley before the third season's measurements.
The lowland comparison retained Meridian barley without expanding it.

cases.evidence: The approved turbopump specification requires alloy R-62 for the replacement thrust collar. Thermal cycling eliminated the earlier D-17 material from consideration.
cases.needle: The approved turbopump specification requires alloy R-62 for the replacement thrust collar.
cases.question: Question: Which alloy is required for the replacement thrust collar? Answer with only the alloy code.
distractors: Alloy D-17 appeared in the prototype collar and failed thermal cycling.
The outer pump casing uses alloy R-26.
Fasteners on the same maintenance order specify alloy R-60.
